calls.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: fully finished COLOR reveal illustration for a hand-drawn nonogram album, first-stage choice image, NOT a puzzle, NOT pixel art. A hanging WIND CHIME (German Windspiel), isolated complete object on a plain warm ivory background. Warm calm hand-drawn 2D storybook illustration, confident clean dark outlines, rich substantial coherent color shapes, carefully finished material details, restrained shading. Portrait composition, object almost fills image height with modest breathing room, entire hanging loop and bottom sail included. Frontal view or only slight perspective, recognizable physical suspension. Clear wide negative gaps between hanging chime tubes, sturdy readable silhouettes; strings may have visible width. Detailed finished illustration, not a flat icon or monochrome silhouette. No other objects, scenery, lettering, watermarks, grid, labels, frame or border. Later abstraction targets exactly 30 cells high with width open, monochrome, but this illustration must remain detailed and fully colored. Variant C: graceful wide wind chime with a single curved dark wood horizontal arch, four separated thick copper tubes of alternating lengths hanging below, visible round wooden clapper between the middle pair, and a large deep turquoise oval wind catcher at the bottom. One small hanging ring centered above and two angled cords supporting the arch. Warm copper and walnut, turquoise sail with a restrained ornamental vein detail. Broad fan-like silhouette compared with variants A and B, still portrait and structurally plausible.
